title: Transfer learning designs signal peptides for recombinant protein secretion in Bacillus
summary: In wet-lab assays, 80% of ML-designed signal peptides secreted the protein of interest and 60% did so at high level. The number of designs was not seen in the abstract.
ai_technology: Transfer-learning ML models with a signal-peptide generator
organization: Tianjin University of Science and Technology, China

evidence.tested: Wet-lab secretion assays in Bacillus amyloliquefaciens
evidence.unknown: Abstract only; number of designs not seen; full text not reviewed.
